entries.appliesTo: Maryland's Future Board (Department of Commerce) and the Comptroller

params.program: Maryland's Future Board visionary-planning + Future Fund

sources.program: § 2.5–302(A), (F)(1) — 'THERE IS A MARYLAND’S FUTURE BOARD IN THE DEPARTMENT' … 'DEVELOPING AND REVISING A VISIONARY PLAN'

flags: AI is tangential: the bill is an economic-development planning act; AI appears only as a required planning topic (§ 2.5–301(E)(4)(II) — 'ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE' among 'STRATEGIES THAT IMAGINE FUTURE TRENDS') and as an optional study factor (§ 2(a)(3)(ii) — 'job replacement due to the rise in artificial intelligence')

no compliance duties on private parties; board/Comptroller obligations (develop visionary plan by January 1, 2027; annual evaluation; project recommendations each August 1; Comptroller study report by December 1, 2026) fit no listed duty key

establishes the Maryland's Future Fund, a 'SPECIAL, NONLAPSING FUND' administered by the Department — no data-centers or infrastructure scope, so no fund-related param exists in the public-sector vocabulary
sunset: Section 3 — 'It shall remain effective for a period of 5 years and, a t the end of June 30, 2031, this Act … shall be abrogated'
crossfiled companion MD SB 770 per legiscan relations ('type': 'crossfiled'); no 'replaced by' relation, so not coded as duplicate
